mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, s.name, s.address, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.phone, s.business_hours, s.cover_image_file_id, COALESCE(sf.url, '/static/default-cover.svg') AS cover_image_url, s.business_status, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM store s JOIN merchant m ON s.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN stored_file sf ON s.cover_image_file_id = sf.id WHERE s.id=#{id}
